nom: Murad Sensitive Skin Gentle Resurfacing Serum

segments.sensitive: The large majority of reviewers identify as having sensitive (including rosacea- or eczema-prone) skin and report that the serum exfoliates, brightens, and reduces redness without stinging, burning, or reactivity.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the serum hydrates, smooths, and revives dull, dehydrated skin without stripping it.
segments.combination: The few reviewers with combination skin describe it as gentle and effective, brightening skin tone without irritation.
segments.mature: One reviewer struggling to find anti-aging products that don't irritate her sensitive skin reports reduced redness and visible resurfacing without irritation.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for fine lines, wrinkles and firmness report visible smoothing and a firmer feel after regular use; no dissent noted.
concerns.dehydration: Most report increased hydration, plumpness and a soothed feel, including on very dry or winter-dulled skin; one reviewer notes the serum layers well but must be paired with a moisturizer, and one warns dark spots and dryness relapse if use is stopped.
concerns.redness: Numerous reviewers, including those with rosacea, report a visible decrease in redness and calming of reactive skin; no reviewer reports increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with reactive or eczema-prone skin state the serum did not damage or further sensitize their skin barrier, and one specifically credits it with reduced overall sensitivity over time.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports dark spots return once she stops using the product, implying the effect is only maintained with continued use; others do not mention spots.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin generally report fewer blackheads, whiteheads or small bumps and no new breakouts; one reviewer prone to over-exfoliation reports no breakouts triggered by this product.

aspects.libelle: No stinging or burning on application
One bottle arrived with rancid smell
Perceived as worth the price for results

extraits.texte: I just received this in my online order and it has a strong rancid smell; I am surmising it is old stock. I have used Murad products in the past without this issue, though this is the first time I have tried this product

I struggle to find effective anti aging products that really work but don't irritate my sensitive skin and this accomplished both! I'm totally blown away how it didn't irritate my sensitive rosacea skin and in find made my skin less red and helped resurface. Gifted by Murad

This serum is amazing ! I have sensitive skin with dry spots and fine lines but have a difficult time finding a serum that won't irritate my skin and leave me looking red and blotchy. I've been using as part of my evening skincare and my skin looks and feels amazing. It's hydrated, brighter and my redness around my cheeks seems to be calmed down and less noticeable . I can't wait to see more progress as the days go on. I couldn't be happier. Gifted by Murad.

Glycolic acid but for sensitive skin?? I was gifted by Murad and I didn't believe it till I tried it!! This product is gentle but effective and my face feels so smooth in the mornings. I'm on day 7 of using this every night and I'm seeing no irritation at all - if this were a stronger product, I'd start getting little red spots and irritation after using it 7 days in a row. It also contains urea, which i love for the eczema on my body but was always afraid to use it on my face. There was no problem at all in this front too. My face overall looks so much smoother and brighter. A true miracle product!

I am so glad I found this product because I feel like there is nothing else quite like it on the market. It is the perfect amount of exfoliation that my skin needs without using a harsh physical exfoliate or a harsh chemical exfoliate. It is just gentle enough for my sensitive and acne prone skin. It does promote cell turnover and exfoliation, which I absolutely love. Complimentary from murad

This product was gifted by murad. Love the way it works quickly on my skin. Fast results. The only drawback is if I stop using it my skin goes back to how it was with the dark spots. The product only works when you use it. Which means you have to continue spending money to purchase item. It doesn't take away the spots permanently.

I have pretty sensitive acne prone skin, which is especially sensitive in the colder seasons. Yet, this product doesn't irritate my skin or damage my skin barrier. It is gentle yet effective. This serum leaves my skin feeling and looking smooth and radiant. Gifted by Murad.
